# USGS Bird Banding Laboratory species list

Third-party data, vendored unmodified. **Not covered by BirdView's Apache 2.0 license**: it is a
work of the U.S. Government, in the public domain in the United States, as the U.S. Geological
Survey states for the data and information it authors.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **File** | `speclist.html` |
| **Origin** | <https://www.pwrc.usgs.gov/BBL/Bander_Portal/login/speclist.php> |
| **Version** | as served on 2026-10-27 |
| **Owner** | U.S. Geological Survey, Eastern Ecological Science Center, Bird Banding Laboratory |
| **License** | U.S. public domain (17 U.S.C. § 105) |
| **Modifications** | None. The page is exactly as served, and its hash is checked on every run of the spec checks. |
| **Used for** | The four-letter alpha (banding) code of each species, joined by scientific name. No other column is read. |

**Credit:** U.S. Geological Survey, Bird Banding Laboratory.

Retrieval details and the SHA-256 this file is checked against are recorded once, in
[river/requirements/imported/usgs.gov/bbl/PROVENANCE.md](../../river/requirements/imported/usgs.gov/bbl/PROVENANCE.md),
and verified by `river/check/pins_test.go`.
